name: io.github.jweezy119/Pabandi
title: PabandiOS
description: Trust OS for service businesses — x402 MCP tools, Solana escrow, AI scoring

tools.name: pabandi_verify_passport
tools.description: Verify a PTP trust attestation (offline-verifiable HMAC signature)

tools.name: pabandi_get_ledger
tools.description: Public audit lookup of a passport issuance charge by idempotency key

tools.name: pabandi_platform_access
tools.description: Grant or inspect an exclusive platform access credential

tools.name: pabandi_get_business
tools.description: Look up a single business by id

tools.name: pabandi_book_stay
tools.description: Book a stay with guest deposit escrow Gated to businesses with an attested open-finance settlement rail OR PTP Band A/B, so every booked stay has a real, verified payout path. This is what makes the hospitality vertical trustworthy to guests and exclusive to quality hosts.

tools.name: pabandi_list_finance
tools.description: List a business's verified settlement rails

tools.name: pabandi_start_escrow
tools.description: Initialize a booking deposit escrow Exclusive: real-chain escrow writes are gated behind a verified PTP trust band (A/B) or an exclusive platform grant, so only trusted counterparties open real money on chain. Verified-only stays use the simulated escrow path. This is the premium moat — the real rail, gated.

tools.name: pabandi_predict_demand
tools.description: Hourly demand forecast for a business

tools.name: pabandi_zk_realestate_proof
tools.description: Issue a ZK proof of escrow split (real-estate / hospitality) Proves the escrow split is correct without revealing the valuation — the privacy + verifiability moat for real-estate/hospitality deals. Upgrades to a succinct on-chain-verifiable SNARK when Barretenberg is in the pipeline.
